extraction: Entries cut from the CmnD package as stored, including their ICU DataHeader (header 144 bytes for .brk/.dict, 32 for .res). Strip headerBytes to get what ubrk_openBinaryRules / RuleBasedBreakIterator(const uint8_t*, uint32_t, UErrorCode&) accept.

entries.name: break_iterator_data_inline_header.h
entries.selectedBy: Blink build-time kFastLineBreakTable for U+0021..U+00FF pairs (223 x 28 bit rows). Generated by the groundwork port of character_property_data_generator.cc (FillFromIcu + FillAscii) over this icudtl.dat; byte-identical (sha256 a32fc28f...) to Chromium's own generator output in the 152 build (out/Trace210/gen/.../break_iterator_data_inline_header.h). The generator source is unchanged 152->153 and every brkitr entry is byte-identical between the two icudtl.dat files, so this is the 153 table.

entries.name: line.brk
entries.selectedBy: @lb=strict for root/other locales, ja, zh, zh_Hant (Blink line-break:strict). ko@lb=strict asks for line_cj.brk, which is not shipped: the open fails with U_FILE_ACCESS_ERROR and Blink reopens with the UI language.

entries.name: line_loose.brk
entries.selectedBy: @lb=loose for root/other locales (Blink line-break:loose).

entries.name: line_loose_cj.brk
entries.selectedBy: @lb=loose for ja, ko, zh, zh_Hant.

entries.name: line_loose_phrase_cj.brk
entries.selectedBy: ja or ko with @lb=loose;lw=phrase (word-break:auto-phrase + line-break:loose).

entries.name: line_normal.brk
entries.selectedBy: ICU "line" for root and every locale without a brkitr bundle of its own (en, de, fr, ru, ar, he, th, hi, yue, und, invalid tags), and for ja and ko with no @lb keyword; "line_normal" (@lb=normal) for those same non-CJ locales. Chromium patches root line from line.brk to line_normal.brk. Blink asks for it with line-break:auto (no keyword) or line-break:normal (@lb=normal) outside ja/ko/zh.

entries.name: line_normal_cj.brk
entries.selectedBy: zh, zh_Hant (zh-CN, zh-TW, zh-HK, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, zh_Hant_TW) with no keyword or @lb=normal; ja and ko with @lb=normal (Blink line-break:normal). Also what an unmatched or empty Blink locale opens when Chrome's UI language is zh (text_break_iterator_icu.cc:72-82).

entries.name: line_normal_phrase_cj.brk
entries.selectedBy: ja or ko with @lb=normal;lw=phrase (word-break:auto-phrase + line-break:normal).

entries.name: line_phrase_cj.brk
entries.selectedBy: ja or ko with @lw=phrase and no lb, or @lb=strict;lw=phrase (Blink word-break:auto-phrase with line-break auto or strict). For other locales ICU ignores lw (brkiter.cpp:444-451).
